notes: Source-only frozen evaluation of DURA, direct, half and two source-only final20 gates; no F/TX/V/target reads or model update.
Four synthetic source clean perturbations of 1% RMS use original DURA estimated action and re-estimated DURA context after injection.
112 source records, first eight in each fixed receiver/view group; pilot disjoint from direct and gate fit, original DURA overlap unknown.
Eight focused tests and independent P0/P1 review passed; real-source checkpoint smoke first.
Source response is a proxy, not identity accuracy, target performance, or an independently blind finding.
